title: PIP-II 650 MHz RF Circulator
agency: ENERGY, DEPARTMENT OF.ENERGY, DEPARTMENT OF.FERMILAB - DOE CONTRACTOR
description_text: Fermi National Accelerator Laboratory (FNAL) is soliciting proposals for the design, fabrication, assembly, testing and delivery of 650 MHz RF Circulators in accordance with the attached Statement of Work in support of the PIP-II Project. Proposal can be submitted directly to the Primary Contact listed on this solicitation notice and within the RFP Document.
